'''Paralope''' were grazing herd animals native to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

Paralope sported two backward pointing horns. Their young had fur in a shade of either gray or black. They were a common sight, and specimens could also be found on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], though its unknown how they arrived there. This goes for most [[Talus/Legends|Talusian]] creatures that ended up on Corellia

The '''acicular defender''' was a subspecies bred for the defense of the herd.
